document.abstract: Annabelle Sheehan will report on the HDTV Drama Workshop that AFTRS Masters students recently completed. This workshop emphasises collaboration and creative work in the context of managing changes in technology and shifts to the post production path. Students produced 3 short dramas and met a range of technical specifications associated with provided material for HDTV.
